Host: Hi, everyone, and welcome to Our Favorite Foods. It's July, and in the US, July is National Ice Cream Month, so today I'm at a small ice cream shop near the beach in Chicago. I'm with Rafael. Rafael, when did you start making ice cream?
Rafael: I started making ice cream last year. I was living in Boston, and I had an office job there. But I got bored, and I decided to try something new. I fell in love with ice cream, and I moved here.
Host: That's really interesting. Was it easy to learn?
Rafael: No, it wasn't easy. I made a lot of mistakes before I learned how to do it well. But I got to eat my mistakes, so it wasn't too bad!
Host: What's the secret to making great ice cream?
Rafael: That's a very good question. I think the best advice is to research your recipe carefully. Find out what other people have already done, and then see if you can do it better.
Host: What are you making right now?
Rafael: Today I'm making strawberry ice cream. People love this flavor. It always sells out quickly.
Host: Do you have any ideas for new flavors?
Rafael: Well, I'm from Brazil, so my açaí ice cream is already on the menu. But I'm probably going to try a seaweed flavor next.
Host: Really? Seaweed?
Rafael: Yes! Sweet and salty flavors are very popular. And people usually want to try something new, just to see what it's like.
Host: I imagine your busiest time is the summer. Is that true?
Rafael: Of course! On a sunny day, people want to spend time outside, and they come to the beach. But even in the winter, business has been good. It's always time for ice cream!
Host: That's good to hear. Thanks for talking to us. Before I go, can I try a scoop of that strawberry ice cream? It looks delicious.
